summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS utilities library but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` a bundled `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a ~700KB Bun-bundled script heavily obfuscated with a string-array rotation encoder (`WV8StW`), a large mixed numeric/string constant array (`n7gIxM`), and a Base85-like decoder (`hc1jfK9`) producing single-line opaque code. The manifest declares `main: index.js` and `files: ["dist", "readme.md"]`, but `index.js` is absent from the tarball and both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped at the root without being declared in `files` — the installed artifact's only effect is to run the obfuscated payload under a downloaded second runtime. A CSS utilities library has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or obfuscated executable code at install time; the shape matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to execute attacker-controlled bytes on the installer's machine while evading Node-resolved static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
